summary: Red-phase test-writing run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Committed 10 ungated structural tests (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/OpenAPIArtifactTests.swift) that fail today because the vendored spec and OpenAPI toolchain do not exist yet, plus 8 gated stubbed-response tests (GeneratedClientContractTests.swift, compiled out via #if canImport(OpenAPIGeneratedCore) until the implementation run lands). Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the real published spec (viamin/color_matching#110, closed) were researched from the server source at viamin/color_matching@main and recorded in docs/openapi-client-test-plan.md for the implementation PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container, so no Swift tests could be executed here; they run on macOS CI (swift test).
